title: incident-bot: runbook linking + SLO auto-diagnostic helpers for on-call summaries
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: improve first-responder efficiency by surfacing relevant runbooks and SLO-focused diagnostics directly in on-call summaries and incident chat flows. This change adds a runbook-linking utility, an SLO auto-diagnostic runner that produces a short human-readable summary, and wiring in the incident summary workflow so on-call messages include actionable links and top-level SLO health indicators.

What this PR does: 1) exposes a runbook lookup API (incident-bot runbook link) that matches incident tags and service names to runbook entries; 2) implements an SLO auto-diagnostic step that queries the slo-toolkit (local cache + remote API fallback) and returns a prioritized list of failing objectives with recent error budgets and suggested next steps; 3) adds a compact on-call summary block that is appended to incident notifications and Slack threads; 4) adds end-to-end unit + integration tests and docs (usage, config, RBAC notes).

Checklist:
- [x] runbook linking implementation and caching
- [x] SLO diagnostic runner with time-window and sampling controls
- [x] on-call summary formatter and Slack attachment template
- [x] tests for matching heuristics and diagnostic outputs
- [x] docs and examples for ops teams

Related: reuses parts of the slo-toolkit API (see ENG-2312) and follows the on-call summary layout defined in incident-bot RFC #202. Links: Linear ENG-2312, SRE runbooks directory (internal link), RFC-202 (design).

review_conversation: Miguel Santos (reviewer): Can we make the cache TTL configurable per-service? In past incidents some services need shorter TTLs.
Aisha Patel (author): Added per-service TTL in pkg/config/schema.yaml and exposed as env override. Updated tests to exercise different TTLs.
Ruth Kim (reviewer): The SLO diagnostic output looks great — please ensure PII is not leaked in the summary. Add masking for user IDs in logs.
Aisha Patel (author): Added masking function and unit test; clarified logging behavior in docs. Also added a flag to disable remote lookups in air-gapped Private deployments.
Jonah Park (approver): Verified integration test against a local slo-toolkit stub, LGTM after CI green.
merge_summary: Squash merged by Ruth Kim on 2026-02-16. Commit message consolidated to: 'incident-bot: runbook linking + SLO diagnostic helpers for on-call summaries (ENG-2312)'. Backported config schema change to release/2026-02 for emergency-private deployments.
release_notes: Adds runbook linking and automated SLO diagnostics to incident-bot on-call summaries. Enables faster triage by surfacing relevant runbooks and top-level SLO health. Configurable cache TTL and Private deployment compatibility. See docs/ops/runbook-linking.md for details.
notes_for_ops: To enable the feature set set INCIDENTBOT_RUNBOOKS_ENABLED=true and configure slo_toolkit endpoint in config. For Private (air-gapped) deployments set INCIDENTBOT_SLO_REMOTE_ENABLED=false and populate local SLO cache snapshot during install.
